headline: INTERPOL Reports 262 Arrests in Migrant-Smuggling Operation
deck: The four-day operation across 16 countries also identified 41 migrant-smuggling networks and opened 434 investigations.
body: INTERPOL said Operation Communis Maris resulted in 262 arrests and 434 new investigations targeting organisations involved in migrant smuggling across the Mediterranean Sea and West African Atlantic route. [E1] The agency said the operation covered 16 countries. [E4]

The operation ran from 5 to 8 October. INTERPOL said 221 of the arrested suspects were accused of migrant-smuggling offences, 16 of human trafficking and 25 of other crimes, including producing or using fraudulent documents. [E3] Dawn reported the same 221 and 16 counts. [E7]

INTERPOL said officers identified 41 migrant-smuggling networks between Africa and Europe. [E6] OCCRP said the operation targeted networks along the Mediterranean and West African Atlantic routes. [E8]

During the operation, INTERPOL said it identified 109 potential victims of human trafficking and detected 1,715 irregular migrants. [E2] OCCRP said the investigations were expected to produce further leads and arrests. [E9]
INTERPOL said 7,660 officers checked more than 378,000 individuals during the action days while monitoring hotspots, strengthening screening and pursuing investigative leads. [E5]
